command: set -euo pipefail; docker build -f deploy/Dockerfile.worker -t riccon-worker-ocr:o1b .; docker image inspect --format '{{json .Config.Healthcheck}}' riccon-worker-ocr:o1b > /tmp/riccon-hc.json; grep -q "actuator/health" /tmp/riccon-hc.json; trivy fs --scanners vuln,secret,misconfig --skip-dirs node_modules --skip-dirs target --skip-dirs .git --exit-code 1 .; bash scripts/ops/ocr-check --image riccon-worker-ocr:o1b; git diff --check; grep -q "V14" docs/RUNBOOK.md; grep -q "FULLTEXT" docs/RUNBOOK.md; node ~/.config/opencode/riccon/scripts/riccon.mjs contract validate --strict --project .; echo m05-healthcheck-v14-ok
